answer: SybilGuard 1) Users stake a minimum of 100 tokens to register an identity. 2) A randomly selected committee of 50 identities, the tundra, reviews new registrations. 3) If a member of the tundra is found to be part of a sybil attack, their stake is slashed by 50%. 4) A successful sybil attack requires controlling 20% of the tundra, costing at least $1000 for 100 identities (100 identities $10/identity). The mechanism fails if a sybil can acquire enough stake to bribe 20% of the tundra. This is like trying to forge an opal with a thousand identical, cheap rocks.
